name: keryx-mcp

tools.name: profile_read
tools.description: Read the verified key owner's private profile and attributed activity. Requires explicit profile:read scope. No public identity, research or payment.

tools.name: profile_update
tools.description: Replace the verified key owner's private display name, handle, one-line bio/purpose and links. Requires explicit profile:write scope. No wallet selector or identity verification; no payment/history changes.

profile.description: Complete replacement; empty text clears a field. Links are bounded HTTPS links to the allowed providers or a public website.

tools.name: paper_lookup
tools.description: Find paper titles, recorded contributors, DOI and exact repository versions without research or payment. Default: retained catalog metadata with observation times. Set searchRepositories=true only to explicitly send the query to arXiv/Crossref (at most two requests, no paper-body reading). Missing DOI, peer review and withdrawal/replacement status remain unknown. Returns a field-scoped bibliography card with provenance, a short reference and reusable BibTeX/RIS text. Use this for exact title/ordered author/year/journal/DOI/version questions before requesting paid research; original paper text is not required for recorded metadata.

query.description: Title/topic (up to 120 characters), exact DOI (up to 200), or versioned arXiv ID/official URL.

searchRepositories.description: Explicit external metadata lookup; false by default. Sends the query to official scholarly providers.

language.description: Language for bibliography labels: en (default), fr or vi. Original titles, author names and venue names are preserved.

tools.name: research_monthly
tools.description: Read the four-request, 30-day Research Monthly quote and handoff. The current quote identifies its payment network. Never buys or redeems a plan.

tools.name: keryx_operator_status
tools.description: Observe public prepaid research operations, queue, recorded ordinary/recovered/unknown completion latency cohorts and hold/review rationale. Timing is order createdAt to updatedAt (acceptance to recorded completion/update); later reconciliation can extend it. It is not first-answer or settlement time. Missing capability stays null. No spending or execution authority; exact books and customer jobs stay private.

tools.name: ask_keryx
tools.description: Ask Keryx — an autonomous research agent that buys paid sources under a budget, answers with inline citations, and pays each cited creator in USDC on Arc. Default deep-mode price is 0.05 USDC service fee + 0.05 USDC creator budget; the POST body sets the exact price. Paid from your own funded Arc Testnet wallet (eip155:5042002; run keryx_wallet_status first). Public research may send your question to Keryx's search provider. The source USDC budget is separate from model and search operating costs. New hosted runs are attributed to the verified paying wallet through agent-to-agent ingress; editable client metadata does not prove stdio identity or grant additional rights. Use when you want a grounded, source-cited answer AND the creators paid for their work. For title, ordered authors, year, journal, DOI or exact arXiv version without reading paper findings, use free paper_lookup with an exact identifier instead.

question.description: The research question to ask Keryx (3–2000 characters after trimming).

budget.description: Optional prepaid creator-spend cap in USDC (default 0.05); added to the deep-mode service fee.

tools.name: keryx_recover
tools.description: Read the saved payment attempt and poll its query ID without submitting another payment. Use after a paid error or uncertain network outcome.

tools.name: keryx_wallet_status
tools.description: Show the configured Arc Testnet wallet (eip155:5042002) the Keryx MCP server pays from: address, balances and readiness. Testnet funds are available through the Circle faucet. Run this before ask_keryx.
